jobs.description: This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: North America, Canada Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Role Overview We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own how our clients get found in search and AI: more than 20,000 real estate websites, each competing in its own market, with a real business depending on the outcome. This is a platform product, where one good product decision reaches thousands of businesses at once. Search is being rebuilt in real time. Our clients are evaluated by Google, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both. This is a product leadership role. You'll run this area like a business: set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and work across design, client success, and sales to make it land. It is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one. You build the case before you build the product, tie your roadmap to retention and revenue, and own the result • Close to your customers. You talk to them often, understand their business, and can explain why something matters in their terms, not just in rankings • You create momentum in ambiguity. You narrow the problem, make a call, and move before every question is answered • Strong opinions, honestly tested. In this role you'll collaborate closely with Science, Clinical, Design, Engineering, Partnerships, Regulatory and Hardware teams to shape the vision, science and product experiences. This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape and improve how millions of people navigate and experience pregnancy and postpartum.The role requires strong AI product fluency and consumer experience. What You Will Do: • Co-create a long term vision that helps those going through pregnancy and postpartum understand their bodies, manage their symptoms, detect risk and take action to improve their health and wellbeing. • Collaborate with a cross functional team, including scientists, clinicians, designers, engineers and commercial team members, to translate research, user insights, scientific findings and complex health concepts into novel product experiences. • Deliver bold and novel pregnancy and postpartum experiences - both wellness and regulated - to members, helping drive member acquisition, retention and measurable health outcomes • Define and prioritize product requirements from early concept through launch, with an iterative and evidence-driven mindset • Lead launch readiness and post-launch iteration • Be accountable for defined adoption, quality, safety, and outcome metrics • Leverage market, qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate product performance and inform future iterations • Contribute to the broader Product team's best practices and help foster a culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement • Collaborate with Regulatory, Legal, and Quality teams on product strategies that align with applicable regulatory frameworks Strong preference for candidates in San Francisco (hybrid with willingness and ability to work in office 1-3 days/week) or Boston (remote). What you'll bring: • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in rapidly scaling or hyper-growth companies with high-quality consumer experiences. • Experience defining, building, and scaling 0-to-1 products that deliver measurable outcomes. • A track record of shipping AI-enabled or AI-native consumer products through launch and iteration. • Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate product discovery, research synthesis, prototyping, analysis, requirements definition, and decision-making. You can articulate how AI has changed your product practice, how you validate AI-generated outputs, and where human judgment remains essential. • Experience partnering with engineering, data science, and design teams to define product behavior, evaluation criteria, feedback loops, quality thresholds, and failure handling. • Deep understanding of healthcare and/or women's health, including demonstrated professional experience and impact building healthcare products. • A track record of working with scientists and clinicians to co-develop high-caliber, science-backed product experiences. • The ability to collaborate and influence through clear written and verbal communication and build strong relationships across diverse teams. Nice to have: • Experience with regulated, privacy-sensitive, or safety-critical products. • Experience defining evaluation frameworks, quality metrics, or feedback loops for AI-powered products. • Experience across software and connected hardware. • Experience working with clinical teams Benefits At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: • Competitive salary and equity packages • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off • Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location
